rows.name: Available
rows.draw: Relaxed open eyes; warm enough to sit with, not a permanent grin.

rows.name: Listening
rows.draw: Open and attentive, a little more lifted than E01.

rows.name: Happy
rows.draw: A clear smile in the eyes; retain some irregularity.

rows.name: Focused

rows.name: Concerned
rows.draw: Gentle inner lift; empathetic, not crying by default.

rows.name: Sleepy
rows.draw: Heavy lids and relaxed weight.

rows.name: Annoyed

rows.name: Surprised
rows.draw: A brief clear widening without enormous eyes.

rows.name: Curious

rows.name: Playful

rows.name: Rest

poses.name: Available
poses.direction: Default between interactions. Tiny gaze changes; most of the time still.

poses.name: Listening
poses.direction: Attend to the user. Closed mouth. One small settle when speech starts.

poses.name: Thinking
poses.direction: Closed mouth, gaze slightly up and sideways. No repeated talking motion.

poses.name: Happy
poses.direction: A short lift or squeeze for a real success. Then settle.

poses.name: Curious
poses.direction: Unequal eye lift; keep the question gentle.

poses.name: Focused
poses.direction: Same art as thinking, centered gaze. For checking a result.

poses.name: Concerned
poses.direction: Empathetic and quiet. No tears in the first release.

poses.name: Sleepy
poses.direction: Slow settle and occasional long blink; not the busy indicator.

poses.name: Deadpan
poses.direction: Mild irritation or dry humor, only when context supports it.

poses.name: Surprised
poses.direction: Brief widened reaction. Close the O again rather than hold it indefinitely.

poses.name: Playful
poses.direction: One small asymmetrical accent. No repeated wink loop.

poses.name: Reassuring
poses.direction: Concerned eyes plus a small smile. Calm and present.

limits: Reference faces were derived from surviving local assets, not new artist work. Original capture sources are missing; ownership and license of earlier reference designs have not been established in this pack. Treat them as functional references, not a request to copy another designer.
A timeline exposure is not a new drawing. An eye-pair unit contains two separately editable eye layers.
Full viseme-driven speech and alternate-drawing playback require runtime integration. Current production speech mainly uses AA/rest.
